description: This source file defines a DebugActions enum containing static methods for opening windows, logs, configuration folders, restarting services, sending notifications and voice commands, performing health checks, managing sessions, port diagnostics, and process management within a macOS application. It encapsulates various debug and control actions specific to the OpenClaw app's development and debugging features.

classes.name: DebugActionError
classes.description: An error type used for representing message errors within debug actions.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a macOS window displaying agent events, using SwiftUI for the content view.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the default file viewer or shows an alert if the log file does not exist.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the configuration folder in Finder.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store file or its containing folder.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification asynchronously.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice message asynchronously and returns success or failure.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the local or remote gateway depending on connection mode.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel for remote mode and refreshes health status.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the log file used for debugging.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate health check.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a test heartbeat to the server asynchronously.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose main logging setting and notifies the server.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application programmatically.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Restarts the onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the session store, considering configuration overrides.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Fetches recent sessions, limited by a specified count.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates session properties on the server.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses open ports related to the gateway.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Kills a process by PID with optional force KILL if termination fails.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store file in Visual Studio Code.
